articles.title: Australian bank NAB apologises after staff learn of layoffs early through automated email
articles.summary: SYDNEY, Nov 23 () - National Australia Bank said on Monday it had apologised to staff after some found out they had ‌been laid off through an automated email accidentally sent before they ‌had been formally notified. The bank, which last month announced plans to slash 2,500 jobs in ​the next year, said the emails were "mistakenly sent" to some employees who had requested a voluntary redundancy package as part of the restructure.
